sources.name: Shigitatsu Sawa Japanese Maple
sources.description: “Shigitatsu Sawa” has a “reticulated” leaf, with a network of prominently-colored green veins with yellow interspaces. In the fall, the leaves change to a red, or rich red-green tone. Small growing up to 4 meters tall, and 3 meters wide. Does well in container or landscape. This is a very nice grafted variegated lace leaf japanese maple.

rhs.description: Upright, then rounded, deciduous tree about 5m tall, with 7-9 lobed leaves 6-10cm long and to 14cm wide, tapering to a sharp point, with toothed margins. The spring leaf colour is creamy yellow-green with a network of dark green veins, turning dark green through summer with even darker green or red veins, then bright red in autumn

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is brightest in partial shade and best protected from hot sun. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure.. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市或庭院花园、乡村风或自然式花园
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 amoenum 类群中的 Acer 品种具有大型掌状叶，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽植于任何保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风位置。叶色在半阴环境下最为鲜艳，也最适合避免烈日灼晒。土壤缺水或过度暴晒都可能导致叶片焦枯。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。

rhs_zh.description: 落叶乔木，初期直立，后形成圆整树冠，高约 5 米。 叶片具 7-9 裂，长 6-10 厘米、宽可达 14 厘米，裂片渐尖，叶缘具齿。 春叶为奶油黄绿色，并具深绿色叶脉网纹；夏季转深绿色，叶脉则呈更深的绿色或红色；秋季变为鲜红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片底色为浅黄色至黄绿色，其上具明显的绿色网状叶脉。 夏季叶色加深，黄色成分更趋绿色，网状叶脉则转为更深的绿色，有时主脉带红色。 到秋季，叶片转为独特的红色，或红绿交融的浓丽色调。 大型叶片略向上杯卷，7 至 9 枚宽卵形裂片向外大幅舒展，约在叶片基部一半处相连，并渐尖为细长锐尖。 叶缘具整齐而锐利的锯齿。 这个非常古老、相当健壮的品种在最炎热的日照条件下适合适度遮护。 其生长为中型直立株，高约 16 英尺（5 米），开展可达 13 英尺（4 米）。 名称可能意为“从沼泽中惊起、呱呱鸣叫的沙锥”，也可能指某个古地名。 'Shigure bato' 属 Matsumurae Group，绿色类。 其小型直立叶片极为优美，通常 7 裂且深裂，细小的基部裂片向后张开，使叶形呈现迷人的羽毛状效果。 每个狭长裂片逐渐延伸成细长先端，且往往略向下弯。 叶缘深且不规则具锯齿。 春叶鲜红，夏季转绿，但叶尖及较大裂片仍保留红晕。 秋色为金红色。
